ordered_transformations: Preserve raw_completion unchanged and record its SHA-256.
If present, remove exactly one complete leading <think>...</think> prefix from only the derived candidate.
If present, unwrap exactly one full Python Markdown fence from only the derived candidate.
Parse the derived candidate with Python ast.parse without importing or executing it.
Require the expected entry_point as a top-level function.
Write only task_id and solution to the scorer samples JSONL.
accepted_forms: one closed leading reasoning prefix followed by valid Python source
one full python Markdown fence containing valid Python source
one closed leading reasoning prefix followed by one full python Markdown fence
rejection_rules: unclosed, repeated, or non-leading reasoning tags
